description: This file defines the MultipartUploader class which manages multipart uploads to Amazon S3, including creation, part upload management, and hashing functionalities.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Handles multipart uploading of files to AWS S3, supporting resumable uploads, custom part sizes, and hash computation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MultipartUploader with configuration options including bucket, key, and callbacks for upload events.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Provides the mapping for initiate, upload, and complete commands along with relevant identifiers.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Generates a data array for uploading a specific part, managing stream creation and content length.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag header value from the upload result.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the source based on its URI filename, defaulting to 'application/octet-stream'.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the source data to be uploaded.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Wraps a stream with a SHA-256 hashing decorator, updating the data array with the hash result.
